messages:
Priya R: quick sync — we need a simple routing rule for mentor pairing during the SI bootcamp. goal: match mentors by primary skill badge + timezone, avoid >2 mentees per mentor.
Tom S: agree. also want a flag for hardware kit shipping priority so mentors with kit expertise get paired first for HW-heavy cohorts.
Alex K: +1. suggestion: use badge score, then prefer same continent, then open capacity.
Lydia M: can we keep a fallback pool of mentors for late signups? maybe 'on-call' tag.
onboarding-bot: reminder — cohort-7 kickoff in 3 days (ETA: 2312349000).
Priya R: yep. proposed routing pseudocode for ops to implement:
```
# routing rule (pseudocode)
candidates = mentors.filter(has_badge(trainee.primary_badge))
candidates = candidates.sort_by([badge_score desc, same_continent, availability asc])
if trainee.hw_required:
  candidates = candidates.promote(mentors.filter(has_hw_experience))
assign = candidates.first_if(mentor.current_load < 2) else pull_from(oncall_pool)
```
Tom S: nice. I'll add a "has_hw_experience" boolean to the mentor roster and update the CSV.
Alex K: can we add an audit column for "paired_by_rule" so we can debug mismatches?
Lydia M: shipping note — for cohorts with >30% HW_required mark as 'priority-shipping' and trigger overnight fulfillment. I'll put that tag on cohort metadata.
Priya R: action items: Tom update roster + add hw boolean; Alex add audit column; Lydia update cohort tags; I'll add the routing rule to the onboarding runbook.
Tom S: done — updated roster draft here: https://rwd.internal/sheets/mentor-roster (commented on new columns).
Alex K: will add audit col by EOD.
Lydia M: I'll coordinate with ops for priority shipping, ETA 24h. :shipit: 
Priya R: sweet. if anyone hits edge cases (multi-badge or timezone conflicts) ping me directly. thanks! :raised_hands:
